paite: Nebukadnezzar vaihawm akum nih kum in Nebukadnezzar in mang anei a; alungsim abuai mahmah a, a-ihmutheita kei hi.
heading: Kumpipa Nebukadnezzar Mangneihna
english: In the second year of the reign of Nebuchadnezzar, Nebuchadnezzar dreamed dreams; and his spirit was troubled, and his sleep went from him.

paite: Kumpipa'n mitkhialdawi tawite leh bum mite leh aisan mite leh Kaldai mite, kumpipa mang hilh ding a sap ding thu apia hi. Huchi in ahong lut ua kumpipa ma ah ahong dinghta uhi.
english: Then the king commanded that the magicians, the enchanters, the sorcerers, and the Chaldeans be called to tell the king his dreams. So they came in and stood before the king.

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n akiang uah, "Mang ka nei a, huai mang thei ding in ka lungsim abuai mahmah hi,” achi hi.
english: The king said to them, “I have dreamed a dream, and my spirit is troubled to know the dream.”

paite: Kaldai mite'n kumpipa kiang ah Siria pau in, "Aw kumpipa, tangtawn in dam in; na sikhate na mang hilh in, ahilhchetna ka ensak ding uh," achi uhi.
english: Then the Chaldeans spoke to the king in the Syrian language, “O king, live forever! Tell your servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

paite: Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Kaldai mite kiang ah, hiai thil kei a kipan apaikheta; mang leh ahilhchetna ka kiang a na hon theihsak kei ualeh atnen in na om ding ua, na innte uh ekvum asuak ding.
english: The king answered the Chaldeans, “The thing has gone from me. If you don’t make known to me the dream and its interpretation, you will be cut in pieces, and your houses will be made a dunghill.

paite: Himahleh mang leh ahilhchetna na hon theihsak ualeh kei a kipan in thilpiakte leh kipahman leh nakpitak a zahtakna na mu ding uh; huaiziak in mang leh ahilhchetna hon ensak un,” achi hi.
english: But if you show the dream and its interpretation, you will receive from me gifts, rewards, and great honor. Therefore show me the dream and its interpretation.”

paite: Anihveina ding in amau adawng ua, "Kumpipa'n mang hon hilh henla, kou ahilhchetna ka ensak ding uh," achi uhi.
english: They answered the second time and said, “Let the king tell his servants the dream, and we will show the interpretation.”

paite: Kumpipa'n adawng a, "Kei a kipan hiai thil apaikheta chih na muh ziak un, hun hihsau tum na hi uh chih ka theitel hi.
english: The king answered, “I know of a certainty that you are trying to gain time, because you see the thing has gone from me.

paite: Himahleh mang ka kiang a na hon theihsak kei uleh, nou a ding in dan khat kia a-om; hun akikhen tan a, ka ma a thuzuau leh sia gelkhol na hih ziak un; huaiziak in mang hon hilh unla, ahilhchetna na hon ensak thei uh chih ka thei ding," achi hi.
english: But if you don’t make known to me the dream, there is but one law for you; for you have prepared lying and corrupt words to speak before me, until the situation changes. Therefore tell me the dream, and I will know that you can show me its interpretation.”

paite: Kaldai mite'n kumpipa adawng ua, "Kumpipa thudot ensak thei leitung ah kuamah a-om kei; kumpipa hiam, toupa hiam, vaihawmmi kuamah in mitkhialdawi tawi kuamah hiam, bummi kuamah hiam, Kaldai mi kuamah mah huchibang thu adot ngei louh ziak un.
english: The Chaldeans answered the king and said, “There is not a man on the earth who can show the king’s matter, because no king, lord, or ruler has asked such a thing of any magician, enchanter, or Chaldean.

paite: Kumpipa thil deih vangtak ahi, mihingte lak a sa a om lou pathiante chih louh ngal, midang kuamah in kumpipa ma ah huai a-ensak thei kei ding uh," achi uhi.
english: It is a rare thing that the king requires, and there is no other who can show it before the king except the gods, whose dwelling is not with flesh.”

paite: Hiai ziak in kumpipa aheh mahmah a, athangpai tuntun a, Babulon mipil tengteng hihmang ding in thu apeta hi.
english: Because of this, the king was angry and very furious, and commanded that all the wise men of Babylon be destroyed.

paite: Huchi in thupiak piakkhiak ahita a, mipilte thah ding ahong hita ua; Daniel leh alawmte thah ding in azong uhi.
english: So the decree went out, and the wise men were to be slain. They sought Daniel and his companions to be slain.

paite: Huchi in Daniel in kumpipa veng sepaih zaheutu Ariok, Babulon mipilte that ding a kuankhe pa kiang ah thuhilhna leh thupil toh dawnna akiksak hi.
heading: Pathian In Mangkhiakna Daniel Atheisak
english: Then Daniel returned answer with counsel and prudence to Arioch the captain of the king’s guard, who had gone out to kill the wise men of Babylon.

paite: Ariok kumpipa sepaih zaheutu adong a akiang ah, "Bangziak a kumpipa a kipan thupiak huchi tel a kin ahia?" achi hi. Huchi in Ariok in Daniel kiang ah athil omdan atheisak hi.
english: He answered Arioch the king’s captain, “Why is the decree so urgent from the king?” Then Arioch made the thing known to Daniel.

paite: Daniel alut a, amah a dia hun sehsak ding in kumpipa angen hi, huchi a ahilhchetna kumpipa a-etsak theihna ding in.
english: Daniel went in, and desired of the king that he would appoint him a time, and he would show the king the interpretation.

paite: Huchi in Daniel a-inn ah apai a, Hananiah, Mishael, Azariah, alawmte kiang ah huai thil atheisakta hi.
english: Then Daniel went to his house and made the thing known to Hananiah, Mishael, and Azariah, his companions:

paite: Huchi a amaute'n hiai thuguk tanchin a van Pathian zahngaihnate angettheihna ding un; huchi a Daniel leh alawmte Babulon a mipilte alakte toh amanthatlouhna ding un.
english: that they would desire mercies of the God of heaven concerning this secret, that Daniel and his companions would not perish with the rest of the wise men of Babylon.

paite: Huchi in zan mengmuhna ah Daniel kiang ah thuguk taklat in a-omta hi. Daniel in van Pathian aphat hi.
english: Then the secret was revealed to Daniel in a vision of the night. Then Daniel blessed the God of heaven.

paite: Daniel in adawng a: Tangtawn tangtawn in Pathian min phat in om hen; pilna leh hatna amah a ahi.
english: Daniel answered, “Blessed be the name of God forever and ever; for wisdom and might are his.

paite: Ama'n hunte leh hunbite ahih lamdang a; kumpipate asuankhia a, kumpipate atungkhia a; mipilte kiang ah pilna apia a, theihsiamna theite kiang ah theihna apia hi.
english: He changes the times and the seasons. He removes kings and sets up kings. He gives wisdom to the wise, and knowledge to those who have understanding.

paite: Thil thukte leh thil gukte ataklang a, mial a om bang ahia chih athei a, akiang ah khovak a-om hi.
english: He reveals the deep and secret things. He knows what is in the darkness, and the light dwells with him.

paite: Na tung ah ka kipak a, ka hon phat hi, Aw nang ka pipute Pathian, pilna leh hatna hon pepa, nang ka hon nget uh ka kiang ua hon theisakpa'n; kumpipa thu ka kiang uah na hon theisakta ngal a, chi in.
english: I thank you and praise you, O God of my fathers, who have given me wisdom and might, and have now made known to me what we desired of you; for you have made known to us the king’s matter.”

paite: Huaiziak in kumpipa'n Babulon mipilte hihse dia asehpa Ariok kiang ah Daniel ava hoh a, akiang ah, "Babilon mipilte hihmang ke'n; kumpipa ma ah hon pilut inla, kumpipa kiang ah ahilhchetna ka ensak ding," ava chi hi.
heading: Daniel In Kumpipa Mang Leh Hilhchetna Agen
english: Therefore Daniel went in to Arioch, whom the king had appointed to destroy the wise men of Babylon. He went and said this to him: “Don’t destroy the wise men of Babylon. Bring me in before the king, and I will show to the king the interpretation.”

paite: Huchi in Ariok in kintak in kumpipa ma ah Daniel apilut a, akiang ah, "Judah saltangte lak ah mi khat ka mu a, ama'n kumpipa kiang ah ahilhchetna atheisak ding," achi hi.
english: Then Arioch brought in Daniel before the king in haste, and said this to him: “I have found a man of the children of the captivity of Judah who will make known to the king the interpretation.”

paite: Kumpipa, amin Belteshazzar in adawng a Daniel kiang ah, "Mang ka neih na hon theisak thei in, ahilhchetna na hon theisak thei ding maw?" achi hi.
english: The king answered Daniel, whose name was Belteshazzar, “Are you able to make known to me the dream which I have seen, and its interpretation?”

paite: Daniel in kumpipa ma ah adawng a, "Thuguk kumpipa'n anget mipilte hi in, mitkhialdawi tawite hi in, bum mite hin in, aisan mite hitaleh, kumpipa kiang ah a-ensak thei kei ding uhi.
english: Daniel answered before the king, and said, “The secret which the king has demanded can’t be shown to the king by wise men, enchanters, magicians, or soothsayers;

paite: Himahleh van ah Pathian a-om a, ama'n thugukte ataklang hi; ni nanung lam a bang om ding ahia chih, kumpipa Nebukadnezzar kiang ah atheisak hi. Na lupna tung a na lutang mengmuhna leh na mang hiaite ahi.
english: but there is a God in heaven who reveals secrets, and he has made known to King Nebuchadnezzar what will be in the latter days. Your dream and the visions of your head on your bed are these:

paite: "Nang na hihleh aw kumpipa na lupna tung ah na lungsim sung ah na ngaihtuahnate ahong om ua; tunung chiang a bang ahia hong om ding thu; huan amah thugukte na kiang a taklangpa'n bang ahia hong om ding na kiang ah atheisakta hi.
english: “As for you, O king, your thoughts came on your bed, what should happen hereafter; and he who reveals secrets has made known to you what will happen.

paite: Himahleh kei bel pilna mihing dangte sang a pilna ka neih tam zawk ziak a hiai thuguk ka kiang a taklat ahi kei a; himahleh ahilhchetna kumpipa kiang a theihsak ahihtheihna ding leh nang na lungtang ngaihtuahte na theihna ding ahi zaw hi.
english: But as for me, this secret is not revealed to me for any wisdom that I have more than any living, but to the intent that the interpretation may be made known to the king, and that you may know the thoughts of your heart.

paite: "Aw kumpipa, ngai in, nang milim thupitak na muta hi. Hiai milim hattak mai, avakna thupi mahmah, na ma ah adingh a; amel a kihtakhuai mahmah hi.
english: “You, O king, saw, and behold, a great image. This image, which was mighty, and whose brightness was excellent, stood before you; and its appearance was terrifying.

paite: Hiai milim ahihleh alutang dangka-eng hoih ahi a, a-awm leh abante dangka, agil leh apheipite dal,
english: As for this image, its head was of fine gold, its chest and its arms of silver, its belly and its thighs of bronze,

paite: akhete sik, akhezungte sik leh tungman khenkhat kihel ahi.
english: its legs of iron, its feet part of iron and part of clay.

paite: Suang khut a sek louh huai milim a khepek sik leh tungman deng a kitam nensak dimdem tan in na mu hi.
english: You saw until a stone was cut out without hands, which struck the image on its feet that were of iron and clay, and broke them in pieces.

paite: "Huchi in sik, tungman, dal, dangkate leh dangka-eng toh akitam nenkhawm vek ua, nipi buhphual a buhsi bang mai ahong hi ua; huchi in huih in huaite amutmang a, huai milim dengzan suangpi pen tang thupitak ahong suak a, leitung pumpi adimta hi.
english: Then the iron, the clay, the bronze, the silver, and the gold were broken in pieces together, and became like the chaff of the summer threshing floors. The wind carried them away, so that no place was found for them. The stone that struck the image became a great mountain and filled the whole earth.

paite: Hiai mang ahi a; kumpipa ma ah ahilhchetna ka gen ding uhi.
english: “This is the dream; and we will tell its interpretation before the king.

paite: "Aw kumpipa, nang kumpipate' Kumpipa, van Pathian in akiang a gam leh thilhihtheihna, hatna leh thupinate a piakna na hi.
english: You, O king, are king of kings, to whom the God of heaven has given the kingdom, the power, the strength, and the glory.

paite: Koipeuh a mite tate atenna uah, gam a sate leh van a vasate na khut ah ahon pia hi; amau tengteng tung a vaihawm ding a abawl dangka-eng lutang na hi.
english: Wherever the children of men dwell, he has given the animals of the field and the birds of the sky into your hand, and has made you rule over them all. You are the head of gold.

paite: Nang nung in nang sang a niamzaw gamdang khat ahong dingkhe ding; huchi in lalgam thumna dang, leitung tengteng a thunei ding in.
english: “After you, another kingdom will arise that is inferior to you; and another third kingdom of bronze, which will rule over all the earth.

paite: Huan gam lina sik bang in ahat ding a, sik in akeknensak a thil tengteng anuaisiah bang in sik in hiaite tengteng adelhzan bang in, akeknensak in, adelhzan ding hi.
english: The fourth kingdom will be strong as iron, because iron breaks in pieces and subdues all things; and as iron that crushes all these, it will break in pieces and crush.

paite: "Huan khepek leh khezung na muhte, akhen belvelmi tungman leh akhen sik ahihleh gam hawmzak ahi ding a; himahleh asung ah sik hatna a-om ding a, sik tungman toh helkhawm na muh bangtak in.
english: Whereas you saw the feet and toes, part of potters’ clay and part of iron, it will be a divided kingdom; but there will be in it of the strength of the iron, because you saw the iron mixed with miry clay.

paite: Huan khepek khezungte, akhen sik leh akhen tungman pen ahihleh, huchibang in gam hatna chiang nei, kitapna chiang nei ahi ding hi.
english: As the toes of the feet were part of iron, and part of clay, so the kingdom will be partly strong and partly brittle.

paite: Huan sik leh tungman kihel na muh pen ahihleh, mite chi toh amau akitok hel ding uh; himahleh sik leh tungman akigawm theih louh bang in akikawikip kei ding uhi.
english: Whereas you saw the iron mixed with miry clay, they will mingle themselves with the seed of men; but they won’t cling to one another, even as iron does not mix with clay.

paite: "Huai kumpipate dam lai in van Pathian in gam suksiat a om ngei lou ding, athuneihna midang kiang a nutsiat a om ngei sam lou ding, ahon dingkhesak ding a; himahleh hiai gam tengteng akitam nensak ding a, ahihse vek ding, amah bel tangtawn in adingh ding hi.
english: “In the days of those kings the God of heaven will set up a kingdom which will never be destroyed, nor will its sovereignty be left to another people; but it will break in pieces and consume all these kingdoms, and it will stand forever.

paite: "Huchi in tang a kipan khut a sek louh suangpi ahong omkhia a, sik, dal, tungman, dangka leh dangka-engte a kitamsak dimdem na muh pen ahihleh; tunung chiang a bang ahia hong om ding kumpipa kiang ah Pathian thupi in atheisakta hi; mang omzia theihsa ahi a, akhiakna akichian hi,” achi hi.
english: Because you saw that a stone was cut out of the mountain without hands, and that it broke in pieces the iron, the bronze, the clay, the silver, and the gold, the great God has made known to the king what will happen hereafter. The dream is certain, and its interpretation sure.”

paite: Huaitak in Nebukadnezzar in amai a lei si in Daniel abia a, thillat leh gimnamtui akiang a lan ding in amaute thu apia hi.
heading: Kumpipa'n Daniel Kipahman Apia
english: Then King Nebuchadnezzar fell on his face, worshiped Daniel, and commanded that they should offer an offering and sweet odors to him.

paite: Kumpipa'n Daniel adawng a, "Chihtaktak in na Pathian, pathiante' Pathian leh kumpipate' TOUPA leh thugukte taklangpa ahi; hiai thuguk taklang ding a hihtheihna na neih ziak in," achi hi.
english: The king answered to Daniel, and said, “Of a truth your God is the God of gods, and the Lord of kings, and a revealer of secrets, since you have been able to reveal this secret.”

paite: Huchi in kumpipa'n Daniel aliansak a, thilpiak tampi apia hi, Babulon bial pumpi a heutu leh Babulon mipilte tengteng tung a ukpipapen ding in abawlta hi.
english: Then the king made Daniel great and gave him many great gifts, and made him rule over the whole province of Babylon and to be chief governor over all the wise men of Babylon.

paite: Daniel in Shadrak, Meshak, Abednego, Babulon bial thu leh la tung a koih ding in kumpipa kiang ah angen hi; himahleh Daniel bel kumpipa kongpi ah a-om hi.
english: Daniel requested of the king, and he appointed Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego over the affairs of the province of Babylon, but Daniel was in the king’s gate.
